Add a column snvKeep to the data.frame keep in the specificSNV(pRAIDS)

Source: R/ancestryAnalysis_internal.R
specificSNVColKeep.Rd

TODO

specificSNVColKeep(pRAIDS)

Arguments

pRAIDS

a RAIDSparam an object with all the RAIDS parameters

Value

The function returns a RAIDSparam an object with all the RAIDS parameters updated.

Details

TODO

Author

Pascal Belleau, Astrid Deschênes and Alexander Krasnitz

Examples


dataDir <- system.file("extdata/tests", package="RAIDS")
fileGDS <- file.path(dataDir, "ex1_good_small_1KG.gds")
pRAIDS <- RAIDSparam( fileReferenceGDS=fileGDS)

gdsReference <- snpgdsOpen(filename=fileReferenceGDS(pRAIDS))
snp.chromosome <- read.gdsn(node=index.gdsn(gdsReference, "snp.chromosome"))
snp.position <- read.gdsn(node=index.gdsn(gdsReference, "snp.position"))
snpgdsClose(gdsReference)
set.seed(4235)
tmp <- sample(seq_len(length(snp.position )),100)

df <- data.frame(snp.chromosome=c(snp.chromosome[tmp], rep(1,10)),
                 snp.position=c(snp.position[tmp], 1987486 +10+seq_len(10))  )

specificSNV(pRAIDS) <- df
pRAIDS <- RAIDS:::specificSNVColKeep(pRAIDS)
head(specificSNV(pRAIDS))
#>   snp.chromosome snp.position snvKeep
#> 1             14     23638712    6831
#> 2             10     13125298    4793
#> 3             14     23360155    6644
#> 4             11      3015702    5247
#> 5              7      6187534    3455
#> 6             20      5985134    9874
tail(specificSNV(pRAIDS))
#>     snp.chromosome snp.position snvKeep
#> 105              1      1987501      -1
#> 106              1      1987502      -1
#> 107              1      1987503      -1
#> 108              1      1987504      -1
#> 109              1      1987505      -1
#> 110              1      1987506      -1
